quarterly_data.signal: The full Q2 2026 results release (6-K exhibit) adds regulatory items: the FDA granted fast-track designation to SP0335, an inactivated, adjuvanted egg-based H5 pandemic influenza vaccine candidate in phase 2 studies (early-stage clinical work funded by BARDA, including the Matrix-M adjuvant licensed from Novavax), and to SP0340, a protein-based bivalent human metapneumovirus and RSV vaccine candidate for older adults in a phase 1 study. The FDA approved subcutaneous Sarclisa under the brand name Escena across all existing Sarclisa IV indications, which Sanofi calls the first anticancer treatment administered through both an on-body injector and manual SC administration; an application for Sarclisa SC via manual injection is under review in China. The Dupixent AFRS submission was accepted in Japan, and Dupixent in CSU for children aged two to 11 years is under regulatory review in Japan. Sanofi has 61 projects in its pipeline, including 36 potential new medicines and vaccines.
quarterly_data.figure: FDA fast-track for SP0335 (phase 2) and SP0340 (phase 1); Sarclisa Escena US approval; 61 projects, 36 potential new medicines and vaccines

quarterly_data.signal: Anticipated major pipeline milestones in the Q2 2026 results release. H2 2026: regulatory decisions for Dupixent in CSU children (JP), venglustat in GD3 (US), Fluzone HD/Efluelda in influenza 50 years+ (US) and SP0087 rabies vaccine (EU); regulatory submissions for Nexviazyme in IOPD (US), efdoralprin alfa in AATD emphysema (US) and SP0087 (US); Sarclisa transplant-eligible MM phase 3 data. 2027: Dupixent AFRS decision (JP); phase 2 data for brivekimig in hidradenitis suppurativa and lunsekimig in high-risk asthma; venglustat decisions (EU, JP); fitusiran phase 3 data (12 years+) and submissions (EU, JP); frexalimab RMS phase 3 data and submission; riliprubart CIDP phase 3 data and submissions (US, EU); Sarclisa SC decision (CN) and transplant-eligible MM submission (US); Myqorzo non-obstructive HCM and Redemplo severe hypertriglyceridemia submissions (CN); Fluzone HD/Efluelda decision (EU); SP0202 pneumococcal and SP0218 yellow fever phase 3 data, with an SP0218 submission (EU). 2028: Wayrilz phase 3 data and US/EU submissions in IgG4-RD and wAIHA; Sarclisa smouldering MM phase 3 data and submission; frexalimab SPMS phase 3 data and submission; SP0202 submissions (US, EU) and SP0218 submission (US).

Q2 2026 results release detail: US sales were EUR 6,344 million (+33.5%), Europe EUR 2,141 million (+1.3%), Rest of World EUR 3,112 million (+3.7%) and China EUR 676 million (-4.9%), China hit by polio/pertussis/hib primary vaccines on the decline in childbirths while Dupixent returned to growth in 2026 after a 2025 price adjustment. Dupixent US sales were EUR 3,899 million (+42.8%). Pharma launches reached EUR 1,305 million (+48.3%), including ALTUVIIIO EUR 349 million (+23.7%), Ayvakit EUR 190 million (market pro-forma $221.3 million, +26.4%), Sarclisa EUR 187 million (+35.7%) and Rezurock EUR 163 million (+25.0%); Beyfortus now protects babies in more than 45 countries. R&D expenses of EUR 2,233 million included more than EUR 200 million of wind-down costs from pipeline decisions, and the 81.2% business gross margin benefited from the reversal of more than EUR 200 million of past Sarclisa SC manufacturing provisions. Amvuttra income was EUR 217 million (EUR 57 million in Q2 2025) and the Regeneron alliance line was EUR -1,850 million. 2026 currency sensitivity: a +0.05 USD/EUR move is worth -EUR 1,069 million on net sales and -EUR 0.23 on business EPS.
